controls.title: Verify Only Root Has UID 0
controls.code:
control 'account-accounts-no-uid-except-zero' do
  impact 1.0
  title 'Verify Only Root Has UID 0'
  tag domain: 'Accounts'
  tag evidence: 'inventory-state'
  tag reboot: 'yes'
  tag cis: ['5.4.2.1', '8.2.1']
  tag('pci-dss' => 'Req-8.5')
  tag nist: ['3.1.1', 'AC-6(5)', 'IA-2', 'IA-4(b)']
  tag level_cis: '1'
  tag ssg: 'accounts_no_uid_except_zero'
  describe command('awk -F: \'($3==0 && $1!="root"){print $1}\' /etc/passwd') do
    its('stdout.strip') { should eq '' }
  end
end

results.code_desc: Command: `awk -F: '($3==0 && $1!="root"){print $1}' /etc/passwd` stdout.strip is expected to eq ""

controls.title: All GIDs referenced in /etc/passwd must be defined in /etc/group
controls.code:
control 'account-gid-passwd-group-same' do
  impact 0.3
  title 'All GIDs referenced in /etc/passwd must be defined in /etc/group'
  tag domain: 'Accounts'
  tag evidence: 'inventory-state'
  tag reboot: 'yes'
  tag cis: ['7.2.3', '8.2.2']
  tag('pci-dss' => '8.2.2')
  tag nist: ['CM-6(a)', 'IA-2']
  tag level_cis: '1'
  tag ssg: 'gid_passwd_group_same'
  describe command('awk -F: \'{print $4}\' /etc/passwd | sort -u | while read g; do getent group "$g" >/dev/null || echo "$g"; done') do
    its('stdout.strip') { should eq '' }
  end
end

results.code_desc: Command: `awk -F: '{print $4}' /etc/passwd | sort -u | while read g; do getent group "$g" >/dev/null || echo "$g"; done` stdout.strip is expected to eq ""
results.resource_params: ["awk -F: '{print $4}' /etc/passwd | sort -u | while read g; do getent group \"$g\" >/dev/null || echo \"$g\"; done"]
results.resource_id: Command: `awk -F: '{print $4}' /etc/passwd | sort -u | while read g; do getent group "$g" >/dev/null || echo "$g"; done`

controls.title: Ensure all users last password change date is in the past
controls.code:
control 'account-no-future-pw-change' do
  impact 0.5
  title 'Ensure all users last password change date is in the past'
  tag domain: 'Accounts'
  tag evidence: 'inventory-state'
  tag reboot: 'yes'
  tag cis: '5.4.1.6'
  tag('pci-dss' => '8.3.5')
  tag level_cis: ['1', '2']
  tag ssg: 'accounts_password_last_change_is_in_past'
  describe command('d=$(( $(date +%s) / 86400 )); awk -v d="$d" \'BEGIN{FS=":"}($3 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $3+0>d){c++} END{print c?"ko":"ok"}\' /etc/shadow') do
    its('stdout.strip') { should eq 'ok' }
  end
end

results.code_desc: Command: `d=$(( $(date +%s) / 86400 )); awk -v d="$d" 'BEGIN{FS=":"}($3 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $3+0>d){c++} END{print c?"ko":"ok"}' /etc/shadow` stdout.strip is expected to eq "ok"

controls.title: Lock Accounts After Failed Password Attempts
controls.code:
control 'faillock-deny' do
  impact 0.5
  title 'Lock Accounts After Failed Password Attempts'
  tag domain: 'Accounts (faillock)'
  tag evidence: 'persistent-config'
  tag reboot: 'yes'
  tag bp28: 'R31'
  tag cis: ['5.3.3.1.1', '8.3.4']
  tag('pci-dss' => '8.3.4')
  tag nist: ['3.1.8', 'AC-7(a)', 'CM-6(a)']
  tag level_bp28: 'minimal'
  tag level_cis: '1'
  tag ssg: 'accounts_passwords_pam_faillock_deny'
  describe command('v=$(grep -rh \'^[[:space:]]*deny[[:space:]]*=\' /etc/security/faillock.conf /etc/security/faillock.conf.d/ 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | grep -oE \'[0-9]+\'); { [ -n "$v" ] && [ "$v" -le 3 ] && echo ok; } || echo ko') do
    its('stdout.strip') { should eq 'ok' }
  end
end

  title 'A time-synchronization service is active'

    its('stdout.strip') { should eq 'ok' }
  end
end
